_doc: Test files the lifecycle guard allows to leak. This list only shrinks: the guard fails a listed file that runs clean. 11a pinned 14 files at its base (plus two Linux voice 1b files that arrived after it); 11b added each file's missing teardown and removed its entry. What remains leaks through production code the test cannot release. Keys are paths relative to Client/; `reasons` names why each entry is listed.

reasons.tests/unit/media-visibility.test.ts: App-lifetime singleton under test: lib/media-visibility.ts's once-guarded ensureVisibilityListener installs document visibilitychange and window blur/focus listeners on the first observeMedia call and exposes no way to release them, so the file's first test always ends with them live.
